articles.title: Mister Organ is one of the most unsettling documentaries I’ve ever seen
articles.essence: Mister Organ doesn't reach the level of societal horror of The Act of Killing or the creepypasta-meets-true-crime gruesomeness of Beware the Slenderman, but there's something deeply unsettling about Michael Organ and his intimate campaign of terror against everyone who enters his life. Mister Organ is a documentary by David Farrier, an Auckland, New Zealand journalist. […]

articles.title: Video game ownership bill introduced in Congress
articles.essence: Ritchie Torres of New York's 15th congressional district in the Bronx introduced the Power To The Players Act this week. If passed, the bill would direct the Federal Trade Commission to establish regulations that guarantee consumers ownership of a game when they pay for it, rather than a licensing agreement.

articles.title: Lenovo’s fast, comfy SteamOS handheld is hundreds off
articles.essence: The Legion Go S with SteamOS is a pretty solid alternative to the $789 Steam Deck OLED.
